meta.description: Residential electric rates for the four Avangrid electric utilities, from the OpenEI Utility Rate Database, for toggling between utilities in the battery simulator.
notes: Rates are bundled: delivery plus the utility's default supply, for customers who have not chosen another supplier. Supply prices change monthly (NYSEG, RG&E), twice a year (UI) or yearly (CMP); each rate here is the snapshot in OpenEI for the dates shown.
None of these residential rates has a demand charge.
Schedules are 12 months x 24 hours of indices into `periods`, in local clock time (hour 0 = midnight-1 am), weekdays and weekends separately. Holidays are not distinguished.
Where a rate changed during the data year (CMP and UI on 1 Jan 2026), each plan lists every version with its start and end dates; the last version is the current one.
Taxes and most riders are not included.
